summary: GPG StreamTransform backed by python-gnupg (optional [encryption] extra). wrap() encrypts to specified recipients; unwrap() decrypts using gnupghome keyring. Accepted by Pipeline and infer_pipeline for .gpg/.asc/.pgp suffixes. Raises ValueError if inferred from a path suffix without a GPG instance provided.
lifecycle_notes: Requires `pip install mountainash-utils-files[encryption]` — python-gnupg must be installed
documentation_hooks: Optional dependency — must document the [encryption] extra clearly
GPG(recipients=[...], gnupghome='/path') is the typical constructor
risks: GPG requires a local keyring and gpg binary — integration tests need setup that unit tests skip
Wrong gnupghome path fails at encrypt/decrypt time, not at GPG() construction
